description: Open a manual App Live session for the user to operate by hand; the agent cannot drive it. Use invokeCapability: mobiledevicecontrol to tap/type/read; applive list_apps to reuse an upload.

appPath.description: Local .apk/.ipa in MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR. Check applive list_apps first; if already uploaded pass browserstackAppUrl.

desiredPhone.description: Exact device name, e.g. 'iPhone 15 Pro Max'. Ask the user; never assume.

name: runAppLiveSession
